name: Neurones S.A.
summary: Neurones S.A. provides infrastructure, application, and consulting services in France and internationally. The company offers infrastructure automation, DevOps, cybersecurity, user support, digital workspace, and IT service management, as well as public, private, and hybrid clouds. It also provides digital, UX/UI, mobility,data, and artificial intelligence; SAP integration deployment of new modules and applications; BPM, RPA, dematerialization, and archiving; IT training; and market finance. In addition, the company offers strategy consulting, management and digital transformation consulting, digital marketing consulting, and HR transformation consulting services.
